## By the Numbers

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

# 1. SETUP & READ DATA
gs4_deauth()
sheet_id <- "1reSknnI2NfaYGdCovLiXL7rgnjXCJjLsgrc5rQ39xyw" # Replace with your ID
res_data <- read_sheet(sheet_id, sheet = "Research")

# 2. CALCULATE DASHBOARD STATS
total_projects   <- nrow(res_data)
ongoing_projects <- sum(res_data$Status == "Ongoing", na.rm = TRUE)
total_funding    <- sum(as.numeric(res_data$Funding_Amount), na.rm = TRUE)
```

## Research Distribution by Status

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Create the bar chart
p <- ggplot(res_data, aes(x = Status, fill = Status)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Count", x = "") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") + # Makes the colors look professional
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Convert to interactive plotly chart
ggplotly(p)
```

## Project Search Directory

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Create the searchable table
datatable(res_data, 
          filter = 'top', 
          options = list(pageLength = 10, autoWidth = TRUE, scrollX = TRUE),
          class = 'cell-border stripe')
```
